tasks.title: Announcement #17
tasks.instruction: Listen to a teacher talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript:
The new computer laboratory is looking to hire several students as part time employees. These jobs are available only to students specialized in Computer Science or Computer Engineering. Since the lab is open 24 hours a day and has just opened, students can work at just about any time.
Student employees will be expected to advise student users on how to operate the computers and to fix any problems that arise.

questions.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?

options.A: Hiring student helpers at the computer lab
options.B: Fixing broken computers at the school
options.C: The open hour of the newly opened computer lab
options.D: Instructions on how to use the computer at school

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段通知主要关于什么，属于主旨/话题识别题，需抓住老师整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 老师明确说“The new computer laboratory is looking to hire several students as part time employees”，并说明了招聘对象、工作时间以及工作职责，整段话的核心内容是招聘计算机实验室的学生助理。 选项B：错误。 老师提到学生员工需要解决出现的任何问题，但通知的主要目的是招聘，而非修理电脑。 选项C：错误。 老师提到实验室24小时开放，但这只是招聘信息中的一个细节，并非通知的主要话题。 选项D：错误。 老师提到学生员工需要指导学生用户操作电脑，但通知的目的是招聘，而非提供电脑使用说明。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the computer lab?

options.A: It is available to students at any time of the day.
options.B: It is only available to the students who are specialized in computer science and computer engineering.
options.C: Students in it need to fix any problems themselves.
options.D: Students working in it need to operate computer for users.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于计算机实验室可以推断出什么，属于推理判断题，需抓住老师对实验室的描述进行推断。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 老师明确说“the lab is open 24 hours a day”，说明实验室全天任何时间都对学生开放。 选项B：错误。 实验室对所有学生开放使用，只是招聘的员工限定为计算机科学或计算机工程专业的学生，属于张冠李戴。 选项C：错误。 老师说明学生员工会帮助用户解决问题，而非用户自己解决，属于概念混淆。 选项D：错误。 老师说明学生员工需要“advise student users on how to operate the computers”（指导用户如何操作），而非替用户操作电脑，属于过度推断。
